content: Despite the proven importance of Flickr tags, the problem of embedding Flickr tags has so far received very limited attention. To the best of our knowledge, BIBREF44 is the only work that generated embeddings for Flickr tags. However, their focus was on learning embeddings that capture word meaning (being evaluated on word similarity tasks), whereas we use such embeddings as part of our method for representing locations.
